description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification to revise the Opening and Closing hours of Toddy Taverns
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of the Excise Ordinance, specifically revising the opening and closing hours of Toddy Taverns. It involves a regulatory change (Excise Notification) issued under statutory powers (Section 32 of the Excise Ordinance) and was passed by Parliament. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks for excise operations.
